steps.text: Outside Rhodes Island of Babel, Kazdel

steps.name: Determined Assassin
steps.text: Babel is defenseless, as the Regent said.

steps.name: Cautious Assassin
steps.text: Keep quiet. Stay alert.

steps.name: Cautious Assassin
steps.text: Stick to the original route and find the King. A Route and B Route, stand by.

steps.name: Determined Assassin
steps.text: Their main force is not on the ship. They will need time to call for support.

steps.name: Determined Assassin
steps.text: Babel's guards still haven't noticed us.

steps.name: Cautious Assassin
steps.text: His Highness was right. There is someone high up in the enemy's chain of command helping us.

steps.name: Cautious Assassin
steps.text: All units, enter the ship. We settle this quickly. Avoid anything unexpected.
Ten minutes ago, Amiya was roused by a strange sound.
Babel is continually being maintained and renovated. It has already seen massive changes compared to when she first arrived at her new home.
'Maybe Closure is busy fixing things again?'
The Doctor left Amiya many picture books in her room, with illustrated stories she had never heard of before.
Her favorite is one that tells of someone who falls from the sky riding a fantastical vehicle, and the many adventures that come of it.
But she is not fond of the ending. The hero repairs the vehicle and has to return to the sky, saying goodbye to the children on the ground.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I really don't like all this noise. The Doctor still isn't here...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Theresa... I need to go find Theresa.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hello, Mr. Downing! You dropped your pliers on the ground. Here!

steps.name: Babel Member
steps.text: Thank you, Amiya. Where are you going?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm going to the Speaker's Office to find Theresa. Oh, right. Have you seen the Doctor?

steps.name: Babel Member
steps.text: The Doctor? It's been a few days. That one ought to be in the Command Center overseeing the operation, I think?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I knew the Doctor must be busy with something... Okay. Bye-bye!

steps.name: Babel Member
steps.text: Don't run so fast, Amiya! There's still a lot of places being overhauled on the ship, so make sure you don't trip!

steps.name: Babel Member
steps.text: That girl really is—

steps.name: Babel Member
steps.text: Urgh...

steps.name: Cautious Assassin
steps.text: This one's handled. Proceed.

steps.name: Determined Assassin
steps.text: Our men on the inside are already on standby at every ambush spot. We can begin a coordinated assault at any time.

steps.name: Determined Assassin
steps.text: If you see anyone, don't hesitate. Those left on the ship are no threat.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I brought my book, Theresa—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Huh? Why is the door shut?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Theresa, it's me! Are you in there?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Closure once taught me another way to open the door...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's open!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Theresa—

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: What are you doing here, Amiya?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I heard some loud noises that sounded really close... I got a little scared.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: We can go home soon.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You look tired...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Would you like to stay with me while I work?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Is this... a storybook?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I see. Well, as long as it's for you, I think I can take a short break. The Doctor and Dr. Kal'tsit won't mind.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thank you, Theresa!

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Alright, come sit over here. Once we finish this story, I'll take you to my homeland to play.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: So, where did we leave off last time?

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: Stand back, Duq'arael.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: You are covered in the blood of the mediocre.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: Merely some heirs making ridiculous comments on the situation. Nobody should be making light of that pair of siblings' lives or deaths at this moment.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: It is a grave disrespect.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: Should you not be retreating and defending the inner city right now, Nezzsalem?

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: That has nothing to do with the war I am waiting for.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: Theresis asked you to come and ensure her death?

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: Is this not you being contemptuous of those siblings yourself? The Regent would not stoop to such methods.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: I am only here to witness the end of this war, and the beginning of another.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: If the King of Sarkaz is struck down, I will bear the deathly pall of this moment. On behalf of the King, I will witness the victory I grasp from the abyss.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: So, you still feel sorrow.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: As do you.
The wreath of reeds slowly sinks into the riverbed. The gloomy mists have not dispersed for days.

steps.name: Laqeramaline
steps.text: Aefanyl... Are you still by her side?

steps.name: Laqeramaline
steps.text: For whom does the elegy ring out?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why did you stop, Theresa? We just got to the important part of the story!

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I thought I'd leave a little suspense for you, Amiya. Would you mind if I used another, more comfortable way to tell you this story?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But... Okay.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Watch out, Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: A bubble! Huh? This is—
Black ripples continuously wash over the pure white room, as though Amiya has plunged into a pool filled with ink.
The black bubbles cut off all sound, just as they obscure Amiya's sight.
Beyond the bubbles, Theresa's figure becomes more and more indistinct.
Retreating further into the distance.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There...sa...?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Stay inside for now, Amiya. Sleep well.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You will be safe by my side.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Determined Assassin
steps.text: Theresa. Your Highness...

steps.name: Determined Assassin
steps.text: We will use our lives as proof of the future that the General pursues.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: No, I was sighing about something else.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Honestly, there is no need to cover your face in front of me.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I still remember you from back when you accepted Yliš's orders before his chariot. Your heroism and valor in that battle moved me.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I remember most of your fellows as well.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You are all worthy of the title of 'brave warrior', in no way inferior to those heroes fighting in Kazdel this very moment.

steps.name: Determined Assassin
steps.text: We aren't covering our faces to hide our identities. We knew they would do nothing here.

steps.name: Determined Assassin
steps.text: We have cut off our horns, abandoned our names, even destroyed every inch of our skin that can be used to identify us. All so that after we use such wretched methods to kill the King of Sarkaz—

steps.name: Determined Assassin
steps.text: We will not be remembered by the Sarkaz. We can't be remembered.

steps.name: Determined Assassin
steps.text: Do it.
The rushing air engulfs the assassins' blades like a swamp, as they incessantly stab forwards.
Swoosh—
The trembling of the blades causes the air surrounding them to resonate. They press on. They continue to stab.
The ones holding the blades are buffeted and submerged by waves they cannot resist.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I remember your names.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I remember you. Luca.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You held back a Steam Knight on your own. You hid yourself within the steam to pull them out, and beheaded them before friend and foe.
The assassin's life fades away.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I remember you too. Liens.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Out of the countless Sarkaz with that name, you are the one who stood out most. After being taken captive by Spire Casters, you freed three of your compatriots from their camp and destroyed their Arts Circle.
Another death, and yet it cannot stop them from approaching Theresa.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: And then you. Levin.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You took an arrow for Theresis, losing an arm in the process, but survived hell itself until you managed to retreat.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I do not wish for you all to die nameless and unknown.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: At the very least... I will remember.
More and more corpses pile up by her side, while the room she has left to stand is whittled away, little by little.
She sighs, wiping the blood from her neck, accidentally smearing the dark red across her white dress.

steps.name: Determined Assassin
steps.text: We want to do something for the Sarkaz before we die. And so now we stand before you...

steps.name: Determined Assassin
steps.text: We have come to kill you. The King we once swore an oath of loyalty to.

steps.name: Determined Assassin
steps.text: We know your strength better than anyone. So, allow us damned traitors to escort you to hell.
